Neese’s Country Sausage is a pork product company based out of Greensboro, North Carolina. The Neese family has been making homemade sausage since the 1800’s, though until the twentieth century it was only for home use. In 1917, JT Neese began selling his family’s sausage products to friends and neighbors in Greensboro out of a covered wagon.
